text: The carrier bears the burden of proving such genuine doubt. [Ralph's Grocery Co. v. WCAB (1995) 38 CA4th 820, 830, 45 CR2d 197, 203] [3:547.1 - 3:547.4] Reserved. (2) [3:547.5] Administrative penalty for repeated violations: Where an employer or insurer knowingly violates Lab.C. § 5814 (¶ 3:546) “with a frequency that indicates a general business practice,” the WCAB may impose administrative penalties of up to $400,000. [Lab.C. § 5814.6(a)] b. [3:548] 10% penalty for delay in payment of temporary disability benefits: A “strict liability” penalty is imposed for late payment of benefits without any showing that the carrier acted “unreasonably.” Lab.C. § 4650 requires the carrier to pay an additional 10% if temporary disability benefits are not paid within 14 days after the insurer is notified of the injury. (This penalty does not apply, however, if the insurer denies liability or notifies the injured employee within the 14-day period what additional information is required to act on the claim.) [Lab.C. § 4650] c.
